title: Count a sit the member started but never finished
detail: A timer left running past the six hour window was deleted on the next page load with no log, so a reflection the member really did left the day empty and broke a 132 day streak (2026-10-25). The stale row now banks a partial log first (clears the day, ticks the streak, 1 Zap, Finish Practice can still top it up), attributed to the day the sit started under the existing one day clamp. An armed pre-roll that never began still earns nothing.

verify.evidence: Test banks the aged out sit as a partial with the started_at day, and banks nothing for an armed pre-roll that never began.
